About this preview

This is an independent proposed website direction for Synboli. Business content is based on the company’s public website. Stock photographs illustrate material and application themes; they do not depict Synboli’s facilities, employees, products or validated results.

Application examples describe areas for development. Final scientific content, performance claims and brand assets should be reviewed with the client.
